description: 移植自 MosaicUI，MIT，Copyright (c) 2026 Darshan Sunil Rajadhyaksha。 https://github.com/darshan-rajadhyaksha/mosaicui/blob/2baca92/src/registry/backgrounds/wavy-threads-background/wavy-threads-background.tsx 画布上的正弦细线。线的偏移按序号播种，不在渲染时取随机数。颜色从画布的计算样式读取。减弱动效停在终态。离开视口时连续动画暂停，回到视口再继续。
